name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(target_room_entered) clause is redundant because the combination of hard Existence(target_picked_up) and hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) already guarantees that target_room_entered will occur. Remove the Existence(target_room_entered) clause and keep the two remaining clauses (Existence(target_picked_up) and Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up)).

CHANGES REQUIRED: the clause `Existence(target_room_entered)` is redundant because the hard `Existence(target_picked_up)` together with the hard `Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up)` already forces `target_room_entered`. Remove that redundant existence clause and keep the other two clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard clause stating that the agent must eventually enter the locked room is redundant. The hard existence of picking up the ball together with the hard precedence already forces the room to be entered first. Remove the first clause and keep the existence of picking up the ball and the precedence clause.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task "Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball." commands that the agent must enter the locked room. This requires a hard Existence(target_room_entered) clause, which is missing. Add a hard Existence(target_room_entered) clause; the existing Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) and Existence(target_picked_up) then correctly capture the goal and ordering.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The agent must eventually enter the locked room." (Existence(target_room_entered)) is redundant because the hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) together with the hard Existence(target_picked_up) already guarantees that target_room_entered will occur before target_picked_up. Remove the redundant Existence clause; keep the two remaining clauses: hard Existence(target_picked_up) and hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up).

texts: The agent must eventually enter the locked room.
The agent must eventually pick up the ball.
The agent must enter the locked room before picking up the ball.
